page.overview:
Who is Yutaro Kurose?

Kurose is a man with short black hair who tends to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Extermination uniform. He has a horizontal scar across his face, a feature he shares with Michiko Tendo.

Like Tendo, Kurose is nervous around Makima and insists that he doesn't want to join the special division.

Kurose has a noticeable accent which he tends to tone down around people from Tokyo.

Kurose's life was ruined by the Gun Devil which was his motivation for joining Public Safety though he never tried to kill it himself, believing it to be impossible.
